Hey ***@zhaohongyi1231***, Welcome to openGauss Community.
All of the projects in openGauss Community are maintained by ***@opengauss-bot***.
That means the developers can comment below every pull request or issue to trigger Bot Commands.
Please follow instructions at **[Here](https://gitee.com/opengauss/community/blob/master/contributors/command.en.md)** to find the details.
@zhaohongyi1231 , PullRequest must be associated with at least one issue.

Hi ***@zhaohongyi1231***, 
if you want to get quick review about your pull request, please contact the owner in first: @greatjigreatji ,
and then any of the maintainers: @lishifu_db , @zhangce_6184
and then any of the committers: @yxfish13 , @excaliburxk , @xulijie09 , @wang-tq , @greatji , @xuanhe
if you have any question, please contact the SIG: [AI](https://gitee.com/opengauss/tc/tree/master/sigs/AI).
